title: Fields to display offers the 13 optional fields with their usual values
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 3 users · 2 browsers · about 30 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Technicians "Esther Howard" and "Ralph Edwards" at this location (the expected results name them, so keep these names), each able to sign in (an email you can open, invitation accepted, password set). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • A Service Advisor (e.g. "James Smith").
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Field Values" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset, so this case's work orders are kept apart from every other work order at the location. The asset has a VIN.
  • One Approved work order for that customer, [WO-1]: Lead Technician Esther Howard, Service Advisor set, 3 lines with labor hours (e.g. 2.0 + 3.0 + 3.0 = 8.0 estimated hours), "Line 2" given to Ralph Edwards in Edit Line, Asset on site turned on.
  • Esther Howard is clocked in on Line 1's Labor row and Ralph Edwards on Line 2's (two people clocked in).
  • Line names in this case (such as "Line 1") are only labels for you: the New Line form's "What Are You Doing?" box only offers ready-made lines (typed text finds no results), so pick any ready-made line for each one (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot") and write down which is which.

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below is active at this location with Time Clock on, or add it: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as "Esther Howard" and "Ralph Edwards" (keep these names), each with an email you can open; accept each invitation and set a password.
  3. Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Field Values" > Save (if it already exists, open it instead). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then VIN/Serial #, Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, TRK-118) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create an Approved work order for "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Field Values": Work Orders > Create Work Order > Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Field Values" and its asset > Save. Record its number as [WO-1] (e.g. "S1-702"). Add 3 lines with labor hours (e.g. 2.0 + 3.0 + 3.0 = 8.0 estimated hours), turning Line Approved on; set Lead Technician "Esther Howard", Service Advisor (e.g. "James Smith"), give "Line 2" to Ralph Edwards in Edit Line, and turn Asset on site on.
  5. In a second browser, sign in as Esther Howard and click Start time clock on Line 1's Labor row, and as Ralph Edwards do the same on Line 2 (two people clocked in).
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Field Values — in List the [WO-1] row shows Lead Technician Esther Howard, 3 lines and a Clocked In value with two people. If not, fix it before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders in List, search for ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Field Values and write down the [WO-1] row's values: Lead Technician, Customer, Asset, VIN/Serial #, Progress, Service Advisor, Clocked In, Lines, Assigned Tech, Total price, On Site, Created on.
  2. Hover the Clocked In value and read the names.
  3. Pick Board View, open Fields to display and count the optional fields offered.
  4. Turn every optional field on.
  5. Compare each field on the [WO-1] card with the List value, and hover the clocked-in field.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Fields to display offers 13 optional fields: lead technician name, customer, asset (year/make/model), VIN/serial, progress, service advisor, clocked in, line count, line technicians, estimated hours, total price, on-site indicator and created date.
  • Each field on the card shows the same value as List for the same work order (e.g. 8.0 estimated hours, 3 lines, the same total price).
  • Clocked in shows the names of the technicians clocked in the way List's Clocked In column does: first name, then +N (e.g. "Esther +1"), and hovering shows every name (Esther Howard, Ralph Edwards).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display (Board View) and columns (Tech View)); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S5-R11, read 8 Oct 2026. PO answer Chris Ward 25 Sep 2026 ("The clocked in field shows technician names, as List does"). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R11: “Offer the optional fields listed below using their existing production meaning.”
  • S5-R11 field list: “lead technician name, customer, asset (year/make/model), VIN/serial, progress, service advisor, clocked in (the names of the technicians currently clocked in to the work order, shown the way List’s Clocked In column shows them today: first name, then +N, with every name on hover), line count, line technicians, estimated hours, total price, on-site indicator, and created date.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
